title: Amplicon Library Preparation
author: Ariel Rabines
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bmuck6sw

steps.title: Prepare 25 µL PCR reaction
steps.instruction: Set up a 25 µL PCR reaction according to the specified components.

steps.title: Run PCR amplification
steps.instruction: Perform the PCR cycling program as required for the amplicon.

steps.title: Verify amplification by gel electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Load 2.5 µL of each PCR product onto a 2 % agarose gel; run the gel and confirm amplification in all samples except negative controls.

steps.title: Purify PCR products with AMPure XP
steps.instruction: Clean up the PCR products using Agencourt AMPure XP beads following the standard PCR purification protocol; elute the purified DNA in 35 µL elution buffer.

steps.title: Quantify purified PCR products
steps.instruction: Measure 1 µL of each purified sample in duplicate using the PicoGreen assay; ensure a proper standard curve and that duplicate CV values are acceptable.

steps.title: Pool normalized library fragments
steps.instruction: Pool purified PCR products to achieve 10 ng per sample (or 20 ng per sample for small libraries) in a single combined library.

steps.title: Concentrate final library with XP beads
steps.instruction: Clean and concentrate the pooled library using XP beads; elute the final library in 45 µL buffer.

steps.title: Assess final library quality and quantity
steps.instruction: Analyze the final library on a TapeStation for size distribution and quantify its concentration using the Qubit fluorometer.
